result:
Scheduled publishing is in: an author can set a "Publish at" date on a post, and until then only that author can see it. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass: 7 tests, including 5 new ones that cover the contract's visibility rules. I also ran `env NODE_ENV=test bun run console posts:scheduled` by hand: it prints only the tab-separated lines on stdout and nothing when no posts are scheduled.

- **Storage:** a nullable `published_at` text column on `posts`, added in a generated migration (`db/migrations/20260929143550_add_published_at_to_posts`) and in `db/schema.ts`.
- **Form field:** `publishAt` is optional on create and edit. A value that isn't a date and time gets the same 422 as an empty title and nothing is saved. On edit, leaving it empty or `null` clears any date and makes the post public immediately.
- **Timestamp format:** every submitted value is converted to UTC before saving (a value sent with a `+02:00` offset is stored as the matching `Z` time). That's because the "has the time passed" check compares the stored text against the current UTC time. Rows written straight into the database in another format could be judged wrong.
- **Who sees what:** the list, search and a post's page all show public posts to everyone, plus the viewer's own scheduled posts. Anyone else asking for a scheduled post's page gets a 404, the same as a missing post.
- **Author view:** each post now carries `publishedAt`. The list and the post page show a "Scheduled" note to the author with the go-live time.
- **Ops report:** `bun run console posts:scheduled` prints `<id>\t<title>\t<published_at>` for each future post, soonest first, and nothing else on stdout.
- **Test clean-up:** the new tests share the database the report reads, so they delete their own posts and users afterwards. I also removed leftover rows from my earlier test runs, so the report comes back empty after the suite.

In summary, I added the `published_at` column in `db/schema.ts` with a migration, and two helpers in `app/Models/Post.ts`: `Post.visibleTo(viewerId)` and `Post.scheduled()`. The `publishAt` check is in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` and `publishedAt` is in `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`. `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` now applies the visibility filter in the list, search and post page, and saves the date on create and edit. The report command is `app/Console/Commands/PostsScheduledCommand.ts`, registered in `src/console.ts`. The regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` types pick up the new field. On the front end, a "Publish at" date-and-time field is in `resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` and `Edit.tsx`, with the scheduled note in `Index.tsx` and `Show.tsx` and date helpers in `resources/js/lib/publishAt.ts`. The new tests are in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`.
